tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Searches Guía Extranjeros, a free trilingual navigator of procedures for foreigners in Spain (residence and immigration, NIE/TIE, arraigo, EX forms, temporary protection, health card, work, benefits, housing, taxes, grants). Returns matching guides with a one-sentence summary, status, the date each

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Returns one guide by slug: summary, first paragraph, how the procedure is filed (online, representative or in person), validity dates, official source domain, up to five key questions and answers, the date last checked and a link to the full guide. Closed or unconfirmed guides return only their stat

tools.name: about_guia
tools.description: Describes Guía Extranjeros: what it covers, languages, number of current guides by topic, data freshness and what is not included.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "about_guia" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Describes Guía Extranjeros: what it covers, languages, number of current guides by topic, data freshness, what is not included, and where to get personal help." → after: "Describes Guía Extranjeros: what it covers, languages, number of current guides by topic, data freshness and what is not included."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
